description: Departures from a stop by Onestop ID or internal ID. Returns each upcoming departure's route, headsign, trip, and scheduled time — plus the real-time predicted time and delay only where the feed publishes GTFS-Realtime. Every departure carries a realtime flag and a schedule_relationship so a static timetable entry is never mistaken for a live arrival, and cancellations/added trips are visible. Resolve a stop to its Onestop ID with transitland_find_stops first. Departures attach to platform-level stops; a parent station may return none — query its child platforms. If a stop returns no departures, widen next_seconds or set use_service_window: true (some feeds only expose times inside their active service window).

limit.description: Maximum departures to return, ordered by departure time. Values above 100 apply the 100-result cap with a notice.

next_seconds.description: Look-ahead window in seconds from now (max 86,400 = 24h). Default 3600 (1h). Widen when a stop has infrequent service or returns nothing.

service_date.description: Restrict to a specific service date (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. to check a future day's schedule. Empty string or omitted uses today. Real-time predictions only apply to the current service day.

stop_key.description: Stop Onestop ID (e.g. "s-9q8yyw3xjw-powell") or internal integer ID. Get one from transitland_find_stops. Use a platform-level stop (location_type 0); a station may return no departures.

use_service_window.description: When true, clamp the query into the feed's active service window. Set this if a default query returns no departures — some feeds only publish times within their declared calendar window.

name: transitland_get_departures

departures.description: Upcoming departures ordered by departure time. A mix of realtime=true and realtime=false entries is normal — only the GTFS-RT-covered trips carry predictions.

items.description: A single upcoming departure (scheduled, with a live prediction when realtime=true).

delaySeconds.description: Predicted delay in seconds: positive = late, negative = early. Null when no real-time data backs this departure.

directionId.description: GTFS direction_id (0 or 1), distinguishing the two directions of travel. Null when omitted.

estimatedTime.description: Predicted departure (ISO 8601 with offset) when realtime=true. Null when scheduled-only.

headsign.description: Trip or stop headsign (the destination shown on the vehicle, e.g. "14 ST via 7 AV"). Null when omitted.

realtime.description: TRUE when this time is a live GTFS-Realtime prediction; FALSE when it is a static scheduled time. The single most important field — never present a FALSE time as a live arrival.

mode.description: Basic or recognized extended GTFS mode (bus, subway, rail, coach, water transport, ferry, …). Urban rail 400–404 uses subway. "unknown" when route_type is missing; "type N" for unmapped present codes.

onestopId.description: Route Onestop ID (e.g. "r-dr72h-m7"). Use with transitland_find_routes.

scheduleRelationship.description: Schedule relationship: STATIC (static-schedule trip, no real-time overlay), SCHEDULED (real-time covered, currently on time), ADDED, CANCELED, UNSCHEDULED, or DUPLICATED. STATIC is the common non-RT value; SCHEDULED indicates RT overlay is active. CANCELED implies the trip is not running even if it appears in the schedule.

scheduledTime.description: Scheduled departure as an ISO 8601 timestamp with the stop's UTC offset (e.g. "2026-06-13T16:21:07-04:00").

tripId.description: GTFS trip_id (feed-local). Identifies the specific scheduled trip.

wheelchairAccessible.description: Trip-level wheelchair accessibility, where the feed states it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `stop_not_found`: The stops array in the API response is empty for the given Onestop ID or internal ID — the API returns HTTP 200 + {"stops":[]} (not a 404) when the stop does not exist. Detected from the empty stops array, not from an HTTP status. `rate_limited`: Transitland returned HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no departures were found.

realtimeAvailable.description: True when at least one departure carried a real-time prediction — i.e. this stop's feed publishes GTFS-RT. False implies all times are scheduled.

stop.description: The stop the departures belong to.

onestopId.description: The stop's Onestop ID, echoed back.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the departure wall-clock times are in.

totalCount.description: Number of departures returned (the API caps server-side; this is the count in the window).

truncated.description: True when departures were capped at the limit.

title: transitland-mcp-server: get departures
